cancellationPolicies.description: This property has a 5 day cancellation policy. Failure to cancel within this time will result in a cancellation charge equal to the first night of your stay, unless otherwise stated (see 'Things to Note' information).

freeCancellation.label: Free Cancellation rates
freeCancellation.description: If you cancel your booking before 23:59 19th Dec 2025 (AEDT) your deposit will be refunded to your payment card. If you cancel after 23:59 19th Dec 2025 (AEDT) or in the event of a no-show, your deposit will not be refunded and the total of the first night's accommodation will be charged to your payment card, unless otherwise stated (see 'Things to Note' information). Please note that cancellations must be made directly within your booking in My Account.
